ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and the Marshall Islands Registrar of Business Organizations designated persons list. Each director, officer, shareholder, and UBO must undergo Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status screening; positive PEP match triggers enhanced due diligence and senior management approval. Source of funds certification and UBO declaration are kept confidential by the registered agent and compliance counsel, available to RMI Law Enforcement and Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful request.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Business Registry — Office of the Registrar of Business Organizations (online name clearance through an authorised registered agent portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official business language. All corporate names must be expressed in the basic Latin alphabet (A–Z, 0–9, and allowed punctuation); Marshallese names are transliterated into Latin characters. No diacritical marks or non-Latin characters are permitted.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name clearance is rejected or the reservation lapses, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Business Organizations within 14 days of rejection. The appeal must include the proposed name, grounds for clearance, evidence of any required ministerial or sectoral consent for sensitive tokens, and the applicant's registered-agent details. The Registrar has 15 business days to issue a decision. Further refusal may be challenged by petition to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands under the judicial-review provisions of Title 33. Extension of a valid reservation may be requested for a further 30-day period upon payment of the statutory extension fee; no extension will be granted once a name is rejected.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. A non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation must maintain a physical registered office in the Marshall Islands provided by the authorised registered agent. The original gaming anti-cheat engine and integrity middleware operations may be performed remotely; a virtual US/APAC VPS or cloud environment is acceptable. The registered office may not be a P.O. Box, and the agent must be available to accept service of process.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% annually in the absence of regulatory red flags, sanctions matches, or adverse media). Because the activity is designated as a Low-Risk Standard banking AML/CFT tier, requires no statutory license, and generates no local employment or physical infrastructure, unannounced on-site inspection is not expected. Higher scrutiny would apply if the entity becomes involved with money-service business activity, cryptocurrency rails, or sanctioned-pegged gaming transactions.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCCA), Title 17 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (Associations Law as amended); incorporation per Sections 24-29, registered office per Section 37, officers per Section 42.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Registrar, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-1) filed in the English language with accompanying notarization.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Non-Resident Business Corporation; no escrow deposit required; shares may be issued for such consideration as the board fixes in accordance with BCCA.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation's Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws, as presented, be and are hereby adopted; that the issuance and allotment of 1,000 Common Shares, par value US$0.01 per share, to the named subscriber be approved; that the registered office at the address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the appointment of the Registered Agent be ratified; that the following officers be appointed: President, Secretary, and Treasurer; and that the President be authorized to execute the Foreign Investment Business License application, open corporate bank accounts, and take all ancillary actions. FURTHER RESOLVED, that all acts of the incorporators prior to this meeting are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request in writing or through the official corporate registry portal; provide up to three proposed names and certify that no similar name is registered; payment of reservation fee is required before issuance of the name certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, file an administrative appeal with the Registrar within 14 days or resubmit an amended name request without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Notarization, and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public qualified under RMI law; final submission to the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation setting forth the corporate name, registered agent and office in Majuro, share structure, and purpose clause covering ISIC 6201 software development; have each incorporator sign in the presence of a notary public; affix notarial certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any deficiency identified by the Registrar and resubmit the notarized Articles within 30 days; the filing will be backdated to the original submission date if cured timely.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Corporate Registry Filing Window, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Articles along with the statutory filing fee and the name certificate; obtain a stamped receipt and the Certificate of Incorporation upon successful processing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, the Registrar will issue a written notice of defect; the applicant has 30 days to cure by amendment; failure to cure results in withdrawal with fee refund.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and First Board of Directors Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Inaugural Board of Directors (principal office in Majuro or by written consent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the board, adopt the corporate bylaws, approve the issuance of shares to the subscriber, fix the registered office address, ratify the registered agent, and appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution minutes or unanimous written consent
Oaths of office for directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If minutes are deficient, the board may adopt a corrective resolution at a subsequent meeting; records shall be restated effective as of the original meeting date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Foreign Investment Division, Ministry of Finance and Foreign Investment Board
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the FIBL application with a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, the Bylaws, an address of the local authorized agent, and the company's business plan for video game anti-cheat middleware; pay the license fee; the license must be obtained before commencing business in RMI.
required_dossiers: Business plan and local agent authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Written grounds for denial will be provided; the applicant may reapply within 30 days with amendments, or appeal to the Foreign Investment Board for reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License and Municipal Fire and Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Majuro Municipal Council Business License Office and Majuro Fire and Public Safety Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the Business House License from the Majuro Municipal Council and secure a Fire Safety Inspection Certificate for the registered office premises, including confirmation of fire alarm, extinguisher placement, and emergency egress; submit the certificate to the Business License Office.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or proof of premises occupancy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection reveals non-compliance, the applicant has 30 days to remediate and request a re-inspection; no additional inspection fee applies for the first re-inspection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Attorney General Tax Division / Ministry of Finance Revenue Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation for any applicable domestic filing obligations; obtain a taxpayer identification number; file the declaration of foreign-source income status confirming tax-exempt treatment under the nontaxable regime for non-resident business corporations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration is queried, resubmit with corrected ownership declarations; retroactive registration may be granted upon proof of original filing date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial manufacturing license applies to ISIC 6201 (computer programming activities); the relevant authority for office-based operations is the Majuro Municipal Council and the Foreign Investment Board.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) issued under the Foreign Investment Act, together with the Majuro Business House License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4 (Administrative/Software Services): no physical industrial installation, no generation of hazardous emissions, and no land disturbance; EIA registration not required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to manufacturing discharges; compliance required with RMI EPA Solid Waste Regulations for office waste, including segregated disposal of e-waste; no wastewater or VOC threshold triggered by software development operations; office generator emissions, if any, must meet EPA ambient air quality standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the Majuro Fire and Public Safety Department confirming compliance with fire code; structural load clearance for office occupancy under the Majuro Building Code; workplace hygiene and occupancy clearance from the Ministry of Health and Human Services.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (MoF) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3: MHL) - Revenue and Taxation Office, Majuro; corporate registration and tax-exempt status administration: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, acting exclusively through licensed Marshall Islands registered agents via the Registrar's e-registry platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Appoint a licensed RMI registered agent and maintain a registered office in Majuro. Step 2: File Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990 (31 MIRC) with the Registrar of Corporations and pay the initial filing fee (USD 250); no minimum capital is required. Step 3: Obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; the entity is automatically classified as a non-resident domestic corporation and, under BCA section 52, is exempt from all RMI taxes, fees, and charges for 25 years from incorporation, except the registration and annual fees. Step 4: No TIN or VAT ID is issued to non-resident BCs; the exemption is evidenced by the statute, the Certificate of Incorporation, and (on request) a Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar. Step 5: If the BC carries on any business inside the RMI or employs RMI-resident staff, it must register with the Revenue and Taxation Office for income tax and withholding (obtain a TIN), register with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration (MISSA), and obtain a business license under the Business Licensing Act - such activity would compromise the non-resident exemption. Step 6: Annual compliance: pay the annual registration fee based on authorized share capital and, if engaged in a relevant activity (e.g., IP business or headquarters), file the annual Economic Substance Return with the Registrar within the statutory deadline.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - Non-resident domestic Business Corporation within the statutory 25-year Marshall Islands tax-exemption zone (BCA section 52); revenue from offshore gaming anti-cheat and integrity middleware is not RMI-source income and is exempt from RMI income, withholding, and capital taxes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No RMI check-the-box election and no hybrid-mismatch legislation exist. Available elections: (i) designation as a non-resident domestic corporation at incorporation (BCA section 52); (ii) a deemed election to resident taxable status upon commencing business within the RMI; (iii) statutory conversion and re-domestication among Business Corporation, LLC, and Limited Partnership forms; (iv) for US federal tax purposes only, eligible owners may file IRS Form 8832 (check-the-box), which has no effect on RMI classification. The RMI has not enacted domestic Pillar Two (GloBE) top-up tax or anti-hybrid rules as of this stage.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - the RMI levies no VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax; indirect taxation is limited to customs import duty, excise-type duties, and the departure green tax, none of which apply to exported digital anti-cheat services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold or regime exists in the RMI. Importers of physical goods must register with Customs, and any entity carrying on a taxable business within the RMI requires a business license; neither obligation arises for the offshore export of anti-cheat middleware services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None - the RMI imposes no real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control mandate. Invoicing follows standard commercial practice under BCA record-keeping requirements, with no government clearance for non-resident service exports.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - with no VAT/GST in force, there is no export zero-rating mechanism or refund claim procedure to invoke. License and subscription income from the video-game kernel-level anti-cheat and integrity middleware supplied to overseas operators is sourced outside the RMI (services performed outside the Republic for non-resident customers) and is excluded from the RMI income tax base; the BCA section 52 exemption confirms that no RMI tax of any kind is leviable on such export income for 25 years from incorporation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable - no customs export declaration is required for digital anti-cheat middleware; no physical goods cross the RMI customs border.
Not applicable - no bill of lading or airway bill exists for SaaS-style license deliveries; the operative export evidence is the executed software license agreement and delivery/acceptance records.
Not applicable - RMI law imposes no inward remittance certificate requirement; counterparty banks may request source-of-funds documentation (invoices, contracts, bank statements) under AML/KYC rules.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT export-refund system exists, so no export zero-rating clawback can arise. Scrutiny focuses on validity of the non-resident exemption: engaging in a trade or business within the RMI, maintaining a fixed place of business in Majuro, or deriving RMI-source income invalidates the BCA section 52 exemption and exposes the BC to corporate income tax (3% of taxable income), gross-revenue and withholding obligations, business-license fees, interest, and penalties under Title 54 MIRC (civil penalties up to 50% of the underpaid tax), plus Registrar sanctions including fines, suspension, or strike-off. Knowingly false non-resident declarations may be prosecuted as registry or tax fraud. The 180-day FX figure is a schema benchmark only; RMI exchange-control law establishes no statutory repatriation deadline for non-resident BCs.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands — the RMI maintains no national central bank; currency issuance and monetary policy are delegated de facto to the US Federal Reserve System under the Compact of Free Association, with US Dollar (USD) as sole legal tender and unlimited legal-tender status.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility on both current and capital accounts. The RMI imposes no exchange controls, no approval requirements for inward or outward transfers, and no differentiated treatment between resident and non-resident accounts. Capital repatriation, dividend remittance, and liquidation distributions are free from licensing, surrender, or waiting periods. The absence of a domestic central bank eliminates both convertibility risk and sovereign FX intervention risks; the only material friction is correspondent-bank compliance screening at the US clearing level.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. There is no statutory timeline for surrender, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no obligation to repatriate export proceeds to a local account. Export receipts may be held in any jurisdiction and currency; because USD is the domestic currency, export invoices in USD require no conversion for local disbursement. For non-USD receipts, free conversion is available through offshore correspondent channels without any central bank filing requirement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility. The RMI has no local Electronic Money Institution licensing regime; the Sovereign Currency Act 2018 authorizes the digital currency SOV through the Sovereign Currency Foundation but does not create an EMI charter for corporate treasuries. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., US-chartered neobanks, UK/EU EMIs, Hong Kong licensed virtual banks) are legally permissible counterparties, but each will independently KYC the RMI Business Corporation under FATF-style standards; the RMI's inclusion on certain correspondent-banking watchlists materially reduces onboarding acceptance rates at US clearing banks. Practical routing: open a US-based arranging account via a permitted correspondent or a Singapore/Hong Kong multi-currency EMI, with BOMI serving as fallback for USD local clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not mandated by RMI banking regulations. BOMI and most correspondent banks permit remote account opening via videoconference for non-resident Business Corporations, conditioned upon physicaliminality of directors being verified through a licensed registered agent certified true copies of passports and proof of address. Any bank ultimately subject to US jurisdiction may require a recorded video KYC interview for the compliance officer and a beneficial-ownership declaration executed electronically by all signatories. In-person attendance is only required if the bank's correspondent relationship fails or if the account is designated for merchant acquiring (Stripe) where directors' identification must clear Visa/Mastercard card-brand screening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with zero local nexus and no audited financial history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation and good standing from the RMI Registrar; registered agent's corporate due diligence pack; management structure; initial capital commitment letter; detailed business plan for the anti-cheat engine; contractual LOIs with gaming studios; UBO declaration with passport notarization and source-of-funds bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner or board member domiciled in a high-risk or sanctioned jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced adverse-media search reports from a recognized AML database; professional reference letters from the RMI registered agent and counsel; sworn affidavit of legitimate source of wealth; audited personal or corporate financial statements; screen printouts of sanctions/PE/PEP filters; explanation of remoteness from the flagged jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Gaming-adjacent scope misclassified as gambling or money-service business, triggering enhanced CDD
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official ISIC 6201 / NAICS 541511 classification certificate; written legal opinion confirming the product is integrity middleware, not wagering; executed anti-cheat software license agreements; compliance policy confirming no gambling payouts, no player funds custody, and no money transmission; statement from RMI Business Corporations Act confirming no gaming license prerequisite.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected inflow/outflow velocity through USD clearing rails without substantiating trade documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreements; invoicing and collection flows; an annual independent IT audit report; bank-specific undertaking to pre-identify counterparties; counterparty onboarding KYC files; treasury policy confirming no third-party settlement payments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder loans from the RMI BC must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the investor's licensed US, Hong Kong, or EU account using ISO 20022 purpose code 'GIT' (General International Trade) for capital injections, or 'TLF'/'COSP' for intercompany loans. US correspondent clearing will engage Fedwire/CHIPS processing; the remitter must include a concise reference formula: 'MH_BC — Shareholder Capital Contribution — [Shareholder Reference]'. Verification bundle comprises the executed board resolution, subscription agreement, RMI registered agent confirmation of issued shares, and source-of-funds evidence from the remitting bank. For Stripe-payable or EMI settlement, the same reference string must be appended to the beneficiary memo to preserve audit evidence across the treasury ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for software licensing, cloud infrastructure, payroll, and subcontractor engineering fees will be executed through: (1) SWIFT MT103 for recurring operational payments, with beneficiary zone and invoice reference; (2) Commercial Freely-negotiable Letter of Credit (MT700) or standby LCs (MT760) when counterparties demand secure settlement for larger licensing or R&D milestones; (3) Documentary collections (MT400/MT422) only for title-backed IP deliverables; and (4) US ACH or domestic Fedwire for USD-denominated vendor payments. Given the RMI's lack of domestic clearing system, all outbound USD wires clear via a US correspondent, and all non-USD settlements must be netted into a single multi-currency account to minimize off-shore rounding and compliance redundancy.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD-native treasury requires no local FX hedge; hedging allowed exclusively offshore for EUR, GBP, KRW, and JPY operating currencies through licensed brokers under ISDA 2002 or 1992 Master Agreements
Non-deliverable Forwards (NDFs) with approved counterparties for currencies with non-convertibility restrictions in the counterparty's home state
OTC vanilla FX forwards with maturities up to 12 months, fully collateralized
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for IRR-matched financing only, restricted to bank counterparties with investment-grade ratings
FX options (plain-vanilla EUR/USD, GBP/USD) for contracted receivables from gaming studios; zero exotic structures permitted

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report and Franchise Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 of each calendar year; no extension is available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-payment penalty of USD 150 is assessed immediately after the April 30 deadline; non-filing or non-payment beyond 90 days subjects the corporation to formal notice and administrative strike-off or dissolution by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act; an audit becomes compulsory only if the company is licensed as a bank, insurance company, or public securities issuer regulated by the Marshall Islands Financial Services Commission, or if ordered by the Registrar for regulatory cause.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting framework; IFRS is commonly adopted for voluntary financial statements, with books kept in U.S. dollars under the accrual basis.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation filing is required under Marshall Islands law; share transfers are recorded in the registered office records and only become reportable to the Registrar in the next annual report if director/officer identity changes.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable; USD 3,000 - USD 8,000 if voluntarily audited

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Marshall Islands corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and gross receipts tax for non-resident Business Corporations; no franchise or similar net-worth tax is imposed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: None - the Marshall Islands does not administer a corporate income tax return for exempt non-resident Business Corporations. Applicable periodic filing is limited to the annual corporate registry report under the Business Corporations Act.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Not applicable for income tax; annual registry filing due before the anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No income-tax return deadline. The annual corporate report is due on or before the last day of the month preceding the anniversary month of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No income tax return appears in the Marshall Islands tax system for this entity class.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors have no income tax filing obligations in the Marshall Islands arising from this entity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No income tax penalty. Delinquent annual corporate report filings are subject to registry late fees and, if remaining unfiled, administrative dissolution after one year.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreement providing dividend relief. Because no domestic dividend withholding tax is imposed, no treaty relief or Tax Residency Certificate is required. A TRC can be obtained from the Registrar only to evidence exempt status for foreign counterparties, if requested.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for outbound royalties and interest; 0% under any limited tax information exchange agreement. No withholding tax is collected by the Marshall Islands.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - no domestic corporate income tax or transfer pricing rules exist in the Marshall Islands; no Local File or Master File threshold is triggered.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply only to entities undertaking 'relevant activities' defined by the International Tax Cooperation Act, including banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, and distribution/service centers. A gaming anti-cheat middleware engine does not fall within these categories; therefore no ESR report is required. The entity must, however, maintain a registered agent, registered office, and adequate records in the Marshall Islands to preserve good standing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting actual trade or business within the Marshall Islands without a domestic operating license or without electing taxable resident status, thereby using the 0% regime as an illegal shelter for onshore income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of income under the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act at statutory rates, plus interest and a penalty of 25% of the tax due; deregistration of the Business Corporation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director(s) may be held jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes and fines; travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed by the RMI court system.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Holding itself out as a substantial operating company while lacking physical office, employees, or decision-making management, particularly if the business services or IP licensing activities are instead performed in an EU/OECD jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of tax-exempt status, monetary penalties up to USD 10,000 per failure in the relevant activity, and compulsory strike-off from the Registrar of Corporations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be subject to civil restitution orders and disqualification from acting as directors of any Marshall Islands entity for up to five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a current beneficial ownership register or failing to disclose ultimate beneficial owners to the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful request, despite the low-risk AML profile of the gaming anti-cheat sector.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines of up to USD 50,000 per violation; the registered office provider may be compelled to resign, causing administrative dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and beneficial owners face criminal liability including imprisonment of up to five years for deliberate false statements in company filings.
